name: The Flash
title: Fastest Man Alive & Scarlet Speedster

attacks.name: Speed Force Lightning Discharge
attacks.description: Hurls crackling yellow Speed Force lightning bolts from fingertips, frying images and layout containers.

attacks.name: Supersonic Arm Cyclone
attacks.description: Spins arms at Mach 3 generating miniature tornadoes that rip navigation headers and throw them airborne.

attacks.name: Infinite Mass Supersonic Punch
attacks.description: Accelerates to near light-speed, delivering a devastating relativistic punch that implodes DOM cards.

voicelines: My name is Barry Allen, and I am the fastest man alive!
Too slow! You didn't even see that coming.
Speed Force is flowing through every pixel!
I just ran around the page four times before you clicked.
